**Fix** (`e93fd8f1c`, `crates/app/src/component_library.rs`). The built-in holder conversion now has a `Clamp::Shrink` arm:
- machine side: the taper, as for the ER and Weldon entries;
- workpiece side: `CYL <bore>`. A shrink-fit chuck grips the shank directly, with no collet. `CYL` takes a plain shank of the bore and a Weldon shank of that size. It refuses all other shanks;
- geometry: `ComponentGeometry::holder` at the library gauge length. This is the same conservative outline that the holder library draws. There is no bore stop, so a solid tool needs a stated stickout (the same as a Weldon entry).

The decision is in `docs/decisions/3919-standard-holders-2.md` ("Shrink-fit chucks in the component library"). A separate `SHRINK` connection code was dropped: it would mate the same shanks as `CYL`.

**Tests** (`crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders/builtin_shrink.rs`, a new module in the existing `tool_library_holders` binary):
- `every_holder_with_a_taper_is_a_built_in_and_a_shrink_fit_bore_is_plain`: each library entry with a taper is a built-in, so no entry drops out in silence. Each shrink-fit built-in has its taper and `CYL <bore>`.
